findings.text: follow-on: the index-stamp fixture is a one-element list, so the production five-element stamp shape and the before[0][:4] stable-prefix comparison at reckon/mcp_views.py:1540 are never pinned; a regression that narrowed the compared prefix would leave the suite green because the fixture carries no element beyond the first.

follow-on: max() chooses the newest run file by lexicographic path order rather than mtime, correct only because run ids are timestamp-prefixed; the docstring's newest-run claim is stronger than what the stamp proves.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit (1de54778 source, 5077e68c evidence); the cache wraps both section_attempts_by_plan and section_attempt_count and adds the concurrency and invalidation tests.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names an input identity, reuse on unchanged inputs, invalidation on launch/promote/discard, a counter test, base/head timings from a read-only script, and a cache-disabled control; the manifest records pytest 106->109 with 0 added failures, measure-base/head logs, and negative-control.log failing both counter assertions at EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make the derived section attempt count cost a read only when its inputs change, guarded by a lock for threaded reads; reckon/mcp_views.py:1520 _cached_attempts reuses the aggregation while the ledger index stamp, the newest run stamp and the live-pointer stamps are unchanged, under _ATTEMPT_CACHE_LOCK at reckon/mcp_views.py:80.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the base 106 passed and head 109 passed gate, the two counter tests, the cache-disabled control, and the base/head timings with their log paths.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff touches exactly reckon/mcp_views.py, tests/test_the_attempts_derivation_is_cached.py and docs/evidence/fragments/section-contract-and-computed-impl/the-attempts-derivation-is-cached.html, all inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_attempts_derivation_is_cached.py:22 and :88 patch ledger.index_stamp to a one-element list, so the production five-element stamp and the before[0][:4] stable-prefix comparison at reckon/mcp_views.py:1540 are never exercised, and the deepcopy independence of returned records is not asserted.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_the_attempts_derivation_is_cached.py:41,52,81 assert reuse and launch/promote/discard invalidation with an installed counter, negative-control.log shows both red at EXIT=1, and measure-base/head.log state roadmap 19.610/3.033 s versus 13.719/1.491 s over the same 1820-run ledger.
justifications.fit: reckon/mcp_views.py:80 mirrors the existing _PROBE_CACHE lock-and-dict idiom and every helper is named by mechanism, though _attempt_inputs at :1493 calls max() on paths to mean newest.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp_views.py:1549 caches section_attempts_by_plan and :1679 caches section_attempt_count against the same input identity, and the recomputation is serialized under the RLock at :80 so threaded reads aggregate once.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff 9a641736..5077e68c touches only reckon/mcp_views.py, the new test file and the evidence anchor, every one a declared write path, with nothing the goal does not imply.
